chars.ABDEL: ABDEL: a young man wearing a mustard yellow hoodie and black joggers with white side stripes.
chars.IMAD: IMAD: a young man wearing a red and white striped football jersey and light blue ripped jeans.
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a young woman wearing a lime green satin bomber jacket over a black dress and big gold hoop earrings.
chars.NEIGHBOR: NEIGHBOR: a stout middle-aged man wearing a long brown hooded djellaba and yellow leather babouche slippers, with a thick grey moustache.
chars.POLICE: POLICE: two Moroccan police officers wearing dark navy blue uniforms with white peaked caps and white belts.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night in the stairwell of an old Marrakech apartment building with terracotta walls. The NEIGHBOR stands furiously in front of a closed wooden apartment door, pointing at it angrily, while three other sleepy neighbors in pyjamas stand behind him whispering and nodding. Tense, accusing mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small messy Marrakech apartment bedroom at night, dim moonlight through the window. IMAD and the GIRL are fast asleep on a mattress on the floor, clothes and a festival wristband thrown on the floor, totally unaware. Calm before the storm.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night, apartment stairwell lit by a harsh ceiling bulb. The two POLICE officers bang hard on a wooden apartment door with their fists, the NEIGHBOR right behind them with arms crossed and a satisfied angry look. Dramatic, loud moment.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside the dark apartment hallway at night. ABDEL, panicked with wide eyes, shakes the sleeping IMAD awake by the shoulder in a bedroom doorway, IMAD sitting up confused and half asleep. Urgent whispering panic.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: View from inside the apartment: ABDEL nervously opens the front door only a little, peeking through the narrow gap with a forced smile, while the two POLICE officers stand outside in the bright stairwell looking at him suspiciously.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Apartment doorway at night. One POLICE officer leans forward, one hand on the half-open door, demanding to come in and search; ABDEL blocks the doorway with his arm, arguing back, tense face-off between them.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: ABDEL steps aside from the open front door with an open-palm gesture inviting the POLICE in, trying to look confident but sweating; the two officers step into the dark apartment living room with flashlights scanning the room.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Apartment entrance at night. The NEIGHBOR stands next to the two POLICE officers, one hand raised as if swearing an oath and the other pointing deep into the dark apartment toward a closed bedroom door; ABDEL stands frozen in shock in front of them. Suspense, everyone staring at the closed bedroom door.
